class.name: GodotDoctorNodeReport
class.brief_description: Holds validation results for a single node within a scene.

method.name: _init
method.description: Creates a new [GodotDoctorNodeReport] for the node at [param node_ancestor_path] with the given [param validation_messages].

method.name: get_num_infos
method.description: Returns the number of [constant ValidationCondition.Severity.INFO]-level validation messages for this node.

method.name: get_num_warnings
method.description: Returns the number of [constant ValidationCondition.Severity.WARNING]-level validation messages for this node.

method.name: get_num_errors
method.description: Returns the number of [constant ValidationCondition.Severity.ERROR]-level validation messages for this node.

method.name: get_node_ancestor_path
method.description: Returns the ancestor path of this node relative to the scene root.

method.name: get_validation_messages
method.description: Returns all validation messages associated with this node.

method.name: get_node_name
method.description: Returns the name of the node, derived from its ancestor path.

members.member: The path of the node relative to the scene root, including all ancestor names.
The list of validation messages associated with this node.
